about_the_game:
ASHWAKE

Experience a hardcore survival game with realistic weapon mechanics, in-depth survival systems, and hostile NPCs, as well as anomalies and creatures. Featuring multiple home bases and factions, tactical weapon handling, permadeath, and extraction systems to safeguard your gear.

LOOTING

Navigate "The Abyss" and search a wide variety of loot containers for gear to sell, craft, or use to advance through the story. Certain items will be required to progress, making looting an essential part of the game, as your character is a scavenger sifting through the remnants of a broken world.

ANOMALIES

The anomalies emerged when the land became unstable after local factories began dumping radioactive waste into the water supply. Additionally, the ongoing conflict between factions in The Abyss led to frequent bombings, chemical warfare, and relentless attacks on one another.

LEVEL TRANSITIONS & EXTRACTS

The world is divided into multiple levels, each with its own unique purpose, requiring players to travel between areas to progress. Levels are connected by transition zones that are on a timer, forcing you to fend off enemies to survive. The extract zones work the same but will return you to your base where you can store your loot, sell/buy with traders, and accept tasks to level up.

FACTIONS

Choose from a variety of factions, each with its own storylines, base, clothing, and side quests to immerse you in the universe. The factions include the Bandits, The Remains, and the Plague Walkers, each offering unique gameplay. Bandits and Remains are rival scavengers fighting for survival, while the Plague Walkers are infected survivors trying to stave off full transformation, struggling each day to survive by seeking a formula to halt the virus.

ROADBLOCKS

Roadblocks are placed to slow progression through the world, ensuring players must reach certain levels to advance through "The Abyss." As you progress through the game, these roadblocks will be removed, allowing access to new areas, loot, and quests.

THE ABYSS

"The Abyss" is what the survivors called it after the breakout happened, but in reality, it’s a warzone that never healed. The area remains full of anomalies, rival factions, monsters, and corruption. In this kill-or-be-killed forgotten land, you must survive "The Abyss" and free yourself and those you care for from the disaster that was brought upon them by humanity itself.

content_descriptors.notes: In the game "FRACTURE: Echoes of the Abyss" there will be swearing when interacting with characters as well as when the main character speaks. The game will depict gore and violence when fighting off enemies including soldiers & zombies as well as graphic mutants that will display visible flesh. There will be very few references to sexual content including posters of models and magazines.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB / Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: ASHWAKE is a challenging single-player first person survival experience that takes place within an anomalous zone in Ozyorsk, Russia. As a lone survivor, you must scavenge for resources, avoid anomalies, and fend off both hostile factions and mutated creatures.
